profile.headline: Fullstack Engineer
profile.summary:
Web frontend developer with three year experience in the field. Mainly focused on front-end development of hybrid Javascript application using frameworks such as Angular or Vue.js.

Worked in projects for national and international clients, performing different tasks in their projects such as:
- Programming of web front-end environments in various programming languages (Angular 2+, Vue.js, Java).
- Connection with API rest services (Spring, AWS)
- Quality Assurance Functions, developing unit and end-to-end testing (Protractor)
- Unit testing developing (Jasmine).

Familiar with Agile technologies, such as Scrum and Kanban, which have been implemented in all the projects during the last year. High teamwork skills acquired by working in big developing teams.

Fully fluent in English, with daily contact with native speaker, and intermediate level in German.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: Skills: AngularJS · TypeScript · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · React.js · Docker Products

positions.title: Lead Frontend Developer
positions.description:
•	Have direct contact with Product owners and divided tasks and workload among the team members.

•	Work with UX and UI designers during the development process.

•	Design and develop a responsive Data Management web platform for a multinational insurance client using the most advanced technologies available.

•	Take part in the creation of CI/CD pipelines together with the DevOps team.

•	Work in an Azure Cloud Platform environment to deploy the application.

•	Enforce the communication between members of the development team and other necessary teams and the existence of rich documentation.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
•	Programmed and designed front-end web applications in various programming languages such as Angular 2+, Vue.js and Java

•	Developed a web planner for an international company to provide a more efficient planning method for factory deliveries, resulting in an overall improvement in time management 

•	Designed, developed and implemented end-to-end testing for completed websites and programs to assure quality functions 

•	Completed unit testing for Angular applications using Jasmine, raising code coverage from zero to ninety percent

•	Worked in teams between five and twenty people following the Agile methodologies to enhance and test websites and applications
 
•	Created hybrid mobile applications using Ionic Framework that provided medical insurance information to users

•	Highlighted code importance by using best practices for a clean and performant application to increase code understanding for future developers

positions.title: English Summer Camp Monitor
positions.description:
•	Monitored more than 60 students, ages 13 to 17, during English summer camp

•	Worked closely and attended weekly planning meetings with other monitors and teachers of different cultural backgrounds

volunteerExperiences.description: My volunteer work at USAC consists of keeping in touch with the exchange students that come to Madrid, and helping them with everything they need, from taking them to their new apartment to help them with their homework
